# Samuel Keter — Cloud Security & DevSecOps Leader

> Samuel Keter is a cloud security and DevSecOps leader and consultant based in Nairobi, Kenya, with more than 10 years of experience securing fintech and tier-1 banking systems. He is currently Staff Engineering Manager, Cloud Security & Compliance at Yassir, and previously worked with KPMG East Africa, Equity Bank Group and PwC Kenya. He holds CCISO (2019) and CEH (2016) certifications and a BSc in Computer Science from Kabarak University.

## Expertise
- Cloud security architecture across AWS, Azure and Google Cloud
- DevSecOps and CI/CD pipeline security, IaC scanning, Kubernetes security
- Fintech and tier-1 banking security: PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, Zero Trust
- IAM hardening, threat modeling, incident command, GRC and audit readiness
- Team leadership: security strategy, board-level reporting, multi-subsidiary oversight

## Key results
- Cut critical cloud vulnerabilities from 48 to 5
- Cut open audit findings from 22 to 3
- Reduced mean incident response time from 45 minutes to 8 minutes
- Security assurance across 6 subsidiaries

## Availability
- Security-leadership roles: remote-first, or relocation to UK / EU / UAE / Singapore / US with sponsorship
- Cloud security and DevSecOps consulting, especially fintech and banking
- Based in Nairobi, Kenya (GMT+3)
